subject: p-prog
title: P.PROG.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 474 (TRF(II)-10). P-PROG (particular progressionalism) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular), TRS (transition) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From SOC-RT-P: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From TRS: POL-CON (political consciousness). From AF-DY: AFI (affinity insight) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From POL-CON: P-FC (particular focus). From LK-IMP: RE-DOC (redocumentation) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: RE-ST (restructuralism).
